llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must configure header options from screen logic using `useLayoutEffect` (for example to set `headerRight`).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No `useLayoutEffect` call is present anywhere in the file. Header options (e.g. `headerRight`) are never configured via `navigation.setOptions` inside `useLayoutEffect`. The code uses `useHeaderButtonPress` instead, which is a different API and does not set header options.
evidence: App.tsx: no import or call of `useLayoutEffect`

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Header action wired in `headerRight` must update component state, and that updated state must be reflected in screen UI.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No `headerRight` option is configured in the navigation header at all. The bookmark button is rendered as a `TouchableOpacity` inside the screen body (`View`), not in the actual navigation header. The `useHeaderButtonPress` hook is misused — it is designed to listen for presses on an existing native header button, not to create one. Therefore there is no header action wired via `headerRight`.
evidence: App.tsx lines 14-15: `useHeaderButtonPress(onToggleBookmark)` — no headerRight option set
App.tsx lines 22-28: bookmark button rendered in screen body, not header
